messages:
Anna Li: Quick triage — final runway check before GA tomorrow. Need owners to confirm SLA, docs, support routing, monitoring alerts, and capacity variance plans. Can each owner ack and call out any gaps?
Matt Gomez: Ack. I'm owning SLA + pricing page. SLA language is done, still waiting on legal to sign the change for credit policy (expect by EOD). Pricing table pushed but need one more pricing sensitivity row for 95th percentile usage.
James Park: Monitoring + runbooks here. All core alerts wired: model latency, queue depth, CPU/GPU OOM, KV cache miss rate. Still missing one log retention policy for Private customers — ops wants an explicit retention window in runbook.
Sara Thompson: Docs + support here. Docs have GA overview, quickstart, and troubleshooting. Support playbook drafted but we need oncall rotations confirmed and escalation matrix (L1->L2->SRE) approved. Asking support managers to confirm by 11:00 PST.
Anna Li: Legal and support signoffs are blockers then. Matt, if legal doesn't sign credits, do we block GA or do we ship with caveat?
Matt Gomez: If legal misses EOD, propose we ship but mark credits as "pending" in billing UI and add clear note in docs. Not ideal but unblocks launch. Need a follow-up task to update customer agreements.
James Park: Regarding capacity variance — perf tests showed 20% tail spikes under burst traffic. Ops-bot simulated a regional failover and we saw sustained queue growth for ~90s. We have auto-fallback to smaller model variants but need to document fallback SLOs and throttling behavior.
ops-bot: load-test: region-eu failover simulated at 2025-11-15T16:34Z — queue depth peaked at 720, drained in 110s after fallback triggered.
Sara Thompson: Can we get explicit owner for fallback messaging to customers? Need wording for emails/push and a status page incident class if fallback is used.
Anna Li: James — can you own fallback SLO doc and the status page taxonomy? Also add a short FAQ blurb for support.
James Park: I can own that. Will drop a PR to runbooks + status page taxonomy by 09:00 tomorrow.
Matt Gomez: Pricing sensitivity row — I need one data point: tail-token-per-request percentile. James, can you add that metric to the perf summary?
James Park: Yep. Will attach the 99th and 95th token-per-request numbers to the perf doc before EOD.
Sara Thompson: Oncall rotations — pinging @support-managers in channel (outside thread). If no confirmation by 11:00 PST, we'll default to the rota in the support playbook and escalate for adjustments.
Anna Li: Last items: dedicated capacity customers — confirm reserved pool sizes and SLA alerts for capacity loss. Ops, please confirm scheduled jobs to warm caches at cutover.
ops-bot: scheduled-job: cache-warmup job queued for GA cutover 2025-11-17T01:00Z UTC. Notified all dedicated owners.
Matt Gomez: Legal update: they approved credit policy with edit — will paste final clause in #legal later.
Anna Li: Summary of action owners: Matt (SLA + pricing caveat), James (fallback SLOs + perf metrics), Sara (support playbook + customer comms), ops-bot (cache warm and runbook hooks). If anyone can't hit these, flag now. Otherwise this thread will be the final triage record. :thumbsup:
Sara Thompson: All good from support side, will confirm rota by 10:45 PST.
James Park: I'll follow up with a PR link when done.
Matt Gomez: Will update pricing table and add note in billing UI about pending credits.
Anna Li: Great — closing triage in 2 hours if no new blockers. Thank you all.
